think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and valid range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether any numeric value(s) have a qualitatively different meaning (e.g., -1/0 meaning disable/auto/infinite) compared to ordinary numeric scaling. 3) Determine if such value breaks the natural ordering semantics (i.e., it’s not just ‘smaller’, it changes the mode). 4) If yes, classify as special and record the special value(s); otherwise classify as non-special.
